title: Earn Crypto with Phemex's Latest Crypto Asset Management Products
notes: First-party announcement stating that Flexible and Fixed Savings would begin on 18 January 2021. Historical promotional risk-free and guaranteed-return wording is preserved as historical company language and is not used as the current canonical risk interpretation.

title: Phemex Terms of Use
notes: Current first-party terms define Phemex Savings as an Earn Product and state Earn Assets are not segregated, may be commingled with Phemex and affiliate assets, may be used for loans and on-chain staking, and in exceptional circumstances may not be returned in full or at all.

title: Phemex Savings
notes: Current first-party product surface confirming continued Phemex Savings availability and flexible/fixed product documentation.

title: What are the Phemex Savings Accounts?
notes: First-party Savings guide documenting interest-generating accounts and noting that product availability can change over time; at the article's reviewed state Flexible Savings was available while Fixed Savings was unavailable.

title: Meet WhiteBIT Earn
notes: First-party announcement introducing WhiteBIT Earn and explicitly renaming SMART Staking to Crypto Lending without affecting existing assets.

title: WhiteBIT User Agreement
notes: Current first-party terms define Crypto Lending as lending digital assets to WhiteBIT, state that it is not a regulated deposit/savings/investment product and does not guarantee fixed returns, describe material crypto-market risks, and allow service restrictions or suspension.

title: Flexible Plans for Crypto Lending
notes: First-party announcement introducing flexible Crypto Lending plans alongside fixed plans.

title: New Long-Term Crypto Lending Plans with Flexible Early Withdrawal
notes: Current first-party notice confirming continued Crypto Lending operation in 2026 and expansion of long-term plans. Product-page principal-return language is not generalized beyond the applicable plan terms.
